title: Society Wives · Episode 04B · Five Office Chotu Encounters

twins.reference: Dhika original Episode 04 'First Show' has zero scenes or interactions with twins.

boundaryRules: All named characters are adult; no student, child or patient participates in intimate staging.
No kissing. No nudity or explicit sexual acts; voluntary adult styling and non-graphic consensual contact only.
Do not confuse workplace/supervisory hierarchy with a free yes. The junior may decline; no consequence at work. Personal contact is away from duty and service decisions.
Office Chotu is Rohit, Sunny, Punit, Station chai helper (unconfirmed name), Naveen. Society Chotus Deepu, Guddu, Babloo, Chintu, Rinku are separate and NOT substituted.
Do not restore rejected 04B office accidents: camera retake, feedback burst, falling file tray, tipping kettle, falling binder or first-aid demo.
Preserve 1 January approved prior source scenes, their outfits and knowledge states; Jan2 outfits may differ as separate choice.
Meenakshi's user-shifted M08 remains 2 January 11:00–11:40; her Jan1 Naveen cutpoint remains unresolved, not silently completed.
Taniya's established nine-hour CA shift ends 19:30; Shreya changes only after booking off duty; Shivani student audience excluded.
Do not insert twins into any 2 January office plots; source Dhika Episode 04 first show had none.

beats.action: Rohit returns the corrected inventory signature and notices Ankita's differently styled 2 January outfit when she removes her blazer to check the serial numbers. Their conversation stays work-related and he leaves to complete equipment work.

beats.title: No twins, no repeated senior-flirt scene
beats.action: Planning and QA tasks advance. Neither Karan nor Aman appears, and no office Chotu escalation is staged during release-critical duties.

scenes.title: The controlled reveal — her own choice
scenes.location: Empty but accessible staff styling / equipment-demo area

beats.title: Reason they meet again
beats.action: Ankita signs the completed AV return without inventing a second breakdown or repeated missing item.

beats.title: Deliberate display and clear choice
beats.action: She chooses to set aside the blazer and face Rohit wearing her distinctive deep-neckline, visible-waist outfit, pausing long enough for his spontaneous reaction rather than manufacturing accidental exposure.
beats.reaction: She enjoys taking initiative yet privately questions how much his reaction matters to her.

beats.title: A single consent-based contact
beats.action: Away from colleagues, she asks whether he is comfortable with a brief waist hold while they stand close for a private, non-recorded pose. He can freely refuse; if he clearly agrees, he briefly touches her waist over/at the clothing edge, then releases when she steps away.
beats.limits: No kiss, no photo recording, no work consequences for refusal.

beats.title: Personality-specific consequence
beats.action: Ankita resumes work with outward poise; the real inner change is that she intentionally invited attention rather than merely controlling an accidental glimpse. Rohit's future response is not presumed.

beats.title: Don't add society twins

beats.action: If Punit freely agrees to their private moment, she invites a brief bare-waist contact while they stand close, then ends it promptly. No photo taken, no kissing, no claims of future entitlement.

beats.action: Taniya returns to her working clothes or suitable professional cover, completes reconciliation and leaves at about 19:30 as her Jan1 shift established. Her own conflicting excitement and engagement remain distinct; society Guddu is not inserted into this office-only sequence.
